authoritative_source.scope_rule: Use second-class-applicable material only; exclude subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕.

priority: materially distinct reasoning variants only after stronger coverage opportunities are exhausted
expansion_policy.fourth_question_condition: The authoritative source explicitly defines at least four materially different states, conditions, exceptions, thresholds, or response branches and Director adjudication records why the fourth requires a distinct decision boundary or reasoning path.

hard_reject_rules: same answer-defining proposition with the same reasoning path and no material boundary change
unsupported inference beyond explicit source support
ambiguous or multiple defensible correct answers
incidental trivia with low exam/practice value
implausible distractors that do not represent credible misconceptions
candidate created solely to satisfy the numeric target

reconciliation.reason: Historical record of the temporary 400-question reconciliation. It is no longer active because the owner subsequently directed release after B18, with no further question-authoring search before this release.
reconciliation.b18_status: The six Director-accepted B18 propositions remain eligible and are the final authoring batch for the 371-question release cut.

preserved_invariants: This historical contract itself does not mutate canonical or released/runtime payloads.
Existing question identities, release history and free selection remain unchanged.
The immutable V0 historical validation snapshot remains unchanged.
No HUMAN review identity is created or implied.
